mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) > 0 FROM USERS U WHERE U.USER_ID = #{userId} AND U.ENABLED = TRUE
SELECT COUNT(1) > 0 FROM ROLES R WHERE R.ROLE_ID = #{roleId} AND R.ENABLED = TRUE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USER_ROLE (ID, USER_ID, ROLE_ID, ENABLED, CREATED_DATE, UPDATED_DATE) VALUES (#{id},#{userId}, #{roleId}, TRUE, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, NULL)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM USER_ROLE WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND ROLE_ID = #{roleId}
